Name: Rupnan's Collection Remake
Author: Rupnan
Description:
[quote][center][size=4][b]NPCs[/b][/size][/center]
[/quote][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51711/51711-1788528341-1326780730.png[/img]
Junimi:
A young girl who resides inside a hollow tree trunk in the forest. Junimi is far more than a simple NPC she is a living extension of the Valley's ancient magic.

Aurelian:
Mayor Lewis's 16 year old grandson from Zuzu City. With a heavy technology addiction, Aurelian brings a cynical perspective that contrasts sharply with the quiet rural life of Pelican Town.

Vicky:
Sharp, analytical, and highly observant, Victoria balances a rigorous academic background with a warm, playful, and affectionate demeanor. Unlike purely theoretical intellectuals, she possesses great social awareness and a genuine desire to connect with the local community.

Kaelen:
A 27 year old veteran and military strategist deployed from Castle Village to secure the mines. Kaelen offers a mature perspective shaped by duty, conflict, and personal honor.

[quote][center][size=4][b][size=4]SHOP & JUNIMOS[/size][/b][/size][/center]
[/quote][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51711/51711-1788528349-680032872.png[/img]
Interact with Litchi and the "Antisocial" Junimos. Forget gold here, you will need to forage Carmine Petals to trade for unique seeds and rare items.

[quote][center][size=4][b]CROPS & TREES[/b][/size][/center]
[/quote][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51711/51711-1788528371-215179478.png[/img]
10 New crops and 2 new fruit trees.

Human Crops:
- Asparagus
- Japanese Pumpkin
- Chinese Cabbage
- Turnip
- Black Beans
- Canephora Bean
- Beach Coconut (Fruit Tree)

Magical Crops:
- Amber Mushroom
- Crystal Bluebell
- Emerald Star
- Junimo Apple
- Ether Fruit (Fruit Tree)

[quote][center][size=4][b]FOOD RECIPES[/b][/size][/center]
[/quote][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51711/51711-1788528381-1436409911.png[/img]
6 new dishes to cook.

Human Dishes:
- Domino Arepa
- Cocada

Magical Dishes:
- Floral Stew
- Igneous Stew
- Amber Stew
- Star Stew

- Includes 2 new Giant Crop.
[quote][center][size=4][b]MACHINES[/b][/size][/center]
[/quote][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51711/51711-1788528394-72449793.png[/img]
3 new processing machines.

Human Machines:
- Sonic Refiner: A high-precision refining machine that processes flowers, gems, sap, ancient scrolls, and trash into useful crafting materials.

Magical Machines:
- Valley Kitchen: A rustic kitchen powered by hearth fire. Requires Junimo crops and forest materials to operate.

- Golden Spirit Statue: A priceless gift awarded to the one who restored life to the Valley. The magic emanating from its surface yields unique daily delicacies.

[quote][center][size=4][b]EXTRAS[/b][/size][/center]
[/quote]- 1 New Villain
- 2 Monsters to eradicate
- 1 New Sword and 1 pair of Combat Boots
- Custom bundles to complete for each character in the story

[b][size=3]CROSS-MOD CONTENT & INTERACTIONS[/size][/b]
This mod features custom events, dialogues, and unique reactions that trigger when playing alongside other popular community mods:

* Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE): Features custom introduction events with Sophia and Andy, along with full schedule and festival integration.

* East Scarp: Includes special story cutscenes and introduction events with Mr. Ginger, Juliet, Jessie, Professor Jasper, Daulton, and Jade.

* Event Reactions & Synergy: 
  - Aurelian and Kaelen feature custom dialogue reactions to events from "Defense Division - Custom NPCs" and "Jorts and Jean".

  - Junimi has unique reactions to events involving "Juna - Roommate NPC".
  - Aurelian reacts to pivotal story moments involving Kaelen from "The Gremio’s Captain".

* Festival Integration: Characters attend custom festivals from "Ridgeside Village (RSV)" and "Love Festival" if installed.

(Note: All cross-mod features are fully automatic and only trigger if the corresponding mods are installed).
[quote][center][size=4][b]WHAT'S NEW IN THIS REMAKE?[/b][/size][/center]
[/quote][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51711/51711-1788527888-1456379434.jpg[/img]
• 100% Hand-Coded: Completely free of AI code. Spent over a month rebuilding and fixing all JSON files from scratch.

• Victoria "Vicky" Included: Victoria is now fully integrated directly into the main mod.

• Unique ID Overhaul: All items and NPCs now use unique internal prefixes {{ModId}}_. Friendship levels with Junimi, Aurelian, Kaelen, Litch, and Xalathar will reset due to these technical changes. Friendship progress with Victoria will NOT be lost, as her previous standalone version already used this system!

• Integrated Stump House: Junimi's home (Stump House) is now built directly into the mod instead of requiring a separate download. Thanks to dedpeech for granting permission to integrate their mod into this remake.

• Improved Junimos: Upgraded portraits for all 6 Junimos thanks to Kalash, plus brand-new winter versions added for each of them.

• Aurelian Visual Overhaul: Updated sprite sheet and portraits, including new beach outfits and a modernized skin tone.

• Reimagined Item Sprites: Completely reworked and polished sprite assets for various items.

• Dynamic Carmine Petals: Now features a winter variation, changing to an icy blue tint when winter arrives.

• New Giant Crop: Added a new Giant Crop variant for the Japanese Pumpkin.

• New Fruit Tree & Recipe: Added the Beach Coconut fruit tree along with a new cooking recipe.

• And much more...

[/quote]- Poltergeister & Jazzybee: For the assets used from the SDV Character Creator.
